items.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: So finally the musical director of the high school, Mr. Klinger, he said, “Well why don’t you join the band since you’re in here all the time?”

ctx.x: How they fit together. What’s the role.

Right. And how everybody was important you know. And Mr. Brooks put that thing together and we did it and Bojangles came, Bill Robinson came in and he spoke to us and he was so uplifting. You know he was so proud to see us. And we were proud to see him. And so he was so complimentary to all of us. And that was a real boost to us. And not only our class, but that particular school was good, it had vocalists, it had other instrumentalists, you know, violins and stuff like that. But just a wonderful school. So in…
